title: Extracellular RNA profiling of serum, plasma, and urine of healthy subjects
description: This study was conducted to generate a reference dataset of extracellular RNA (exRNA) from standard human biofluids. Small RNA-seq data was obtained from plasma, serum, and urine of healthy subjects.
